# RankMaster: Guess the Rank

> RankMaster is an iPhone game where every question states a fact with the rank
> removed — "Australia is the __ largest country on Earth" — and you slide to
> your answer. Closer is better, so being nearly right still scores. It is a
> game about judgement, not memorised lists.

Published by 12F ApS, a Danish company (CVR 45362957). Free, with no ads, no
subscription, no in-app purchases and no tracking.

## Scoring

The whole marking scheme is `points = max(0, 10 - 2 * |guess - correctRank|)`:

| Off by | 0  | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5+ |
|--------|----|---|---|---|---|----|
| Points | 10 | 8 | 6 | 4 | 2 | 0  |

## Game modes

- **Daily** — ten questions, the same ten for every player worldwide, once a
  day, resetting at midnight UTC.
- **Endless** — one question after another, for as long as you like.
- **Categories** — geography, population, sport, economy and nature.

Leaderboards cover today, this week, all-time and each category. Your own place
is always pinned.

## Facts and sources

Every question cites the source its number came from and the year it is from,
shown when the answer is revealed — rankings go stale, so the app says which
vintage you are playing.

## Privacy

- You can play without an account. While anonymous, nothing you play is sent to
  the server at all.
- Sign in with Apple is optional and exists so scores survive a new phone and
  can appear on a leaderboard.
- Your display name is the only thing other players see.
- Anonymous usage analytics are collected with PostHog, hosted in the EU. There
  is currently no in-app switch to turn this off.
- No advertising identifier, no ads, no attribution or ad-network SDKs, and
  nothing is ever shared with data brokers.
- Everything can be deleted from inside the app.

Full detail: https://rankmaster.12f.dk/privacy-policy.html

## Availability

- Platform: iOS 17.6 or later. 24 MB. Rated 4+.
- Price: free.
- Languages: English, Danish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch,
  Norwegian (Bokmål), Portuguese (Brazil), Swedish.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rankmaster-guess-the-rank/id6810373394
